params.caption: 🎮 Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy lands January 28, 2027 Owlcat Games has dated its follow-up to Rogue Trader: the CRPG launches on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on January 28, 2027, with a Switch 2 date to come later. You play an Inquisitor in the Calixis sector, starting as a lowly acolyte and building a band of outcasts to hunt heretics. 🕒 Nov 9, 2026 · 19:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot #Warhammer40K #DarkHeresy #GamingNews
